appearance_facts.fact: The chart title reads 'Falling Respiratory Infection Cases in Sentinel Sites from 2012 to 2023'. This is a printed statement about the trend, not a data point.
A single purple line series connects data points for each year from 2012 to 2023. The line generally trends upward from the left (2012) to the right (2023), with a peak in 2022.
The line starts at a value slightly above the 700 grid line.
The line shows a local dip, falling below the 2014 peak but remaining above the 1000 level (estimated between 1100-1200).
The line reaches its highest point on the chart, significantly above the 2800 grid line (estimated near 3000-3100).
The line ends at a high value, slightly lower than the 2022 peak but still well above the 2800 grid line.

printed_facts.fact: The vertical axis is labeled 'Respiratory infection cases'.
The text below the title reads 'Sentinel surveillance record shown in the dashboard summary'.

public_definitions: Goal: Review the respiratory infection surveillance dashboard and select the operational route that best fits the overall case pattern for this record.
Options: 'Route the record to increasing-activity follow-up', 'Route the record to easing-activity follow-up', 'Route the record to standard surveillance monitoring'.
uncertain: The exact numerical value for each year is not printed on the data points; values are estimated from grid lines.
The title claims the cases are 'Falling', which contradicts the visual upward trend of the line graph from 2012 to 2022.
